lidar_subset.rule: random.Random(seed).sample(sorted segment names from the camera_image bucket listing, n)

time_origin: frame start = key.frame_timestamp_micros (first top-LiDAR scan); all times in ms after it

hypotheses.H_lidar: tau = T_rot * ((pi - theta) mod 2pi) / (2pi); theta = azimuth of the box centre in vehicle axes about the top-LiDAR position (CCW from +x); T_rot = segment median frame interval; one frame = one rotation, so T_rot = sweep period
hypotheses.H_pose: tau = per-frame fitted frame-pose time; frames with ego speed < 2 m/s use 49.8
hypotheses.H_cam: tau = GetPixelTimestamp (segment readout direction) at the column of world_to_image(T_frame*c), the static-point projection of the box centre (exact fixed point; no iteration)

velocity_convention: label speed is in world axes (G4b passed 2026-10-20: median ratio 0.9995 in [0.9,1.1], median angle 0.13 deg <= 10 deg)

inclusion.along_axis_definition: 3D angle between label velocity and the line of sight from the camera position (image pose) to the box centre T_frame*c, both in world axes

association.anchor: midpoint of p(0) and p(tau_max), tau_max = max(t_lidar, t_pose, t_cap); static: p(0)
association.gate_px: 0.5*|p(0) - p(tau_max)| + 40 + 0.25*hull_width; hull_width = mean width of the tau=0 and tau_max hulls
association.solver: Hungarian per image over all projected vehicle hulls and all human vehicle boxes

widening.trigger: unassigned share >= 0.30 among included moving vehicles >= 8 m/s in any camera

association.anchor_hull: tau=0 hull translated so that its centre is the anchor

estimand.projection: Waymo world_to_image_moving_point, unmodified, float64; corners at T_frame*x + v*(t_pose_img - t_frame - tau)
estimand.direction: d = s * e; e = image direction of body-forward axis (static-point projection of centre and centre + 1 m along heading); s = sign(v . heading)
estimand.interval: 95% cluster-robust by segment, CR1 with G/(G-1)

camera_eligibility.halfwidth_formula: 1.96*sqrt(DE_c*V_c); V_c = sum(w^2*sigma_b^2/sdot^2)/sum(w)^2; DE_c = CR1 variance / independent variance of the track-weighted mean static residual of camera c

decision.slope_cells: one pooled cell per readout direction (L2R, R2L), WLS with camera intercepts; per camera x readout slopes are displays
decision.supported_if: CI(delta_H,c) within +-5 ms in every decision camera AND CI(beta_H,r) within +-10 ms per unit xi in every readout direction passing the slope gate
decision.inside_margin_beyond_budget: reported as a bound on the annotation convention, not interpreted

records: post-freeze gate results, hashes and amendments: newpaper/autonomous_driving_crossmodal_fit_selection_2026-10-13/pilot/PILOT_RECORD_XF-C7.md
